m6.scope.device_required: A till’s facts are applied at the shop of the till that sent them
m6.receipt.malformed: The receipt from the till has no document id or issue time
m6.session.malformed: The till session has no id or time
m6.receipt.duplicate_number: Another receipt of the same till series already has this number; both receipts are kept for review
m6.receipt.replay_differs: The receipt arrived again under the same document id with other content; the first copy is kept
m6.receipt.number_jump: The receipt’s number is far past its series’ next number; the series was moved only as far as the configured limit
m6.session.close_replay_differs: The till session’s close arrived again with other amounts; the first close is kept
m6.cash_movement.malformed: The cash movement from the till has no movement id, session id, kind, amount, or time
m6.cash_movement.invalid_amount: Cash movement amount must be greater than zero
m6.cash_movement.reason_required: Reason is mandatory for a cash movement
m6.cash_movement.replay_differs: The cash movement arrived again under the same id with other details; the first copy is kept
m6.session.shortage_review: The till session closed with a cash shortage exceeding the review threshold
